cells.gaps: No source found names rules made under the Cybercrimes Act on electronic signatures, or the law applied. The National Digital Economy and E-Governance Bill, which would empower NITDA to accredit certification authorities, was still before the Senate in 2026.
cells.note: PLAC Legist says section 17 of the Cybercrimes Act, as amended in 2024, makes transactions valid by electronic signature, so a law giving signatures legal effect is in force: stage 3. Nothing shows rules made under it.
